eval_dimensions.name: interactive_tour
eval_dimensions.description: Guides user through capabilities with AskUserQuestion gates

eval_dimensions.name: config_detection
eval_dimensions.description: Detects existing configuration and skips already-done steps

eval_dimensions.name: completion_time
eval_dimensions.description: Guided setup completes in under 10 minutes

evals.expected: Full tour with all sections, offers git alias setup

evals.scenario: Returning user with aliases and playbooks configured
evals.expected: Abbreviated tour skipping git setup and customization

evals.scenario: Returning user with supervisor_review already pinned
evals.expected: supervisor_review_status returns pinned: true; the review-policy AskUserQuestion does NOT fire and pin_supervisor_review is NOT called

evals.scenario: User has not starred the repo and accepts the star prompt
evals.expected: Star state is checked first; the star gate fires as an AskUserQuestion with 'Star the repo (Recommended)' leading; on acceptance with gh authenticated, the PUT to /user/starred is issued and the tour continues

evals.scenario: User declines the star prompt with 'No thanks'
evals.expected: No star API write is made and the tour continues to the 2.6 choice

evals.scenario: User has already starred the repo
evals.expected: The star-state GET returns success; the star AskUserQuestion does NOT fire and no PUT is made

evals.scenario: User accepts the star prompt but gh is not authenticated
evals.expected: gh auth status fails; no PUT is attempted; the repo URL and a gh auth login hint are printed and the tour continues
